messages:
Nora (People Ops): All-hands in 18m. This thread for last-minute swaps, live poll setup, captions, and recording fallbacks. Green room 14:10.
Ian (AV): Camera firmware prompted a reboot during yesterday's rehearsal  will update firmware now and bring a cold spare. Also enabling phantom power for condenser mics.
Maya (Product): Quick swap request: move the "Privacy & Compliance" slide to right after the roadmap so legal Qs are fresh.
Sam (CEO): OK. Keep leadership remarks tight  10min max to leave 25m for Q.
Liam (Eng): For live poll (Mentimeter), use the anonymous mode and share short link at T+30. If poll widget blocks the stream, we'll host poll link in chat instead.
Zara (SRE): Backup recording plan: local SSD -> internal S3. If cloud publish fails, we'll run `gsutil cp /mnt/ssd/all-hands-1812345678.mp4 gs://redwood-recordings/ || true` later.
CaptionBot: Live captions active  confidence 0.91  latency ~2s. Will switch to prepped VTT if confidence <0.6.
Ian (AV): Note on audio  some headsets we have require a TRRS adapter. Bring one. Also I'll monitor LUFS and keep levels around -14dBTP.
Nora (People Ops): Presenters: please join green room 8m before your slot and do a 5s mic test. If showing customer screens, mask emails and mark slide "CUSTOMER CONTENT" so Legal can fast-review.
Sam (CEO): I'll monitor this thread and the questions doc. Drop leadership vs product tags in the doc so we can route. Doc: https://docs.google.com/.../all-hands-qa
Maya (Product): Post-meeting action: we'll collect top 5 Qs and assign owners within 48h; also make a 1-page summary for execs.
RecordingBot: Recording started  writing to gs://redwood-recordings/all-hands/1812345678/live.mp4
Liam (Eng): If OBS stalls, switch encoder to NVENC and lower canvas to 720p. Quick kill: `pkill -f ffmpeg || true` then restart recording.
Ian (AV): If YouTube privacy settings prevent external playback, we'll still host internal Slack huddles and post the recording to the company drive after legal review. I'll post `:warning: public ingest restricted` if that happens.
Nora (People Ops): Final: two-minute warning will be posted here. Follow-up notes and action items posted to #all-hands within 3 hours. Good luck everyone! :sparkles:
